Bio Security and Feed Mill Information
Max moisture 26%
Any live bugs found in grain will result in a rejected load.
All trucks must use the Weaver Wash Prior to arriving at the mill, for their first load of the day. If the truck is going to same location only, they will not need to wash on returning loads. . Truck wash is located at 900 North Center Street Versailles, Ohio 45380.
Grain is Priced at weigh-in.
We will not accept corn from Poultry operations to include Chickens, Turkeys, Ducks, Guinea, geese, quail, ostriches, pigeons, peacocks and pheasants.
Must not have been at a poultry operation within 72 hours of delivery to Buckeye Feed and Grain
Any questions please call the mill prior to arrival.
